raw_segments.text: That I absolutely refuse to answer, gentlemen.
Not because I couldn't, or because I shouldn't dare, or because it would be damaging, for
it's all a paltry matter and absolutely trifling, but I won't because it's a matter of principle.
That's my private life, and I won't allow any intrusion into my private life.
Your question has no bearing on the case, and whatever has nothing to do with the case
I wanted to pay a debt.
I wanted to pay a debt of honor, but to whom I won't say.
